    15  Define the Cauchy distribution with location parameter `x₀` and scale parameter `γ`.
    16  
    17  Note that we use "location" and "scale" to refer to these parameters in theorem names.
    18  
    19  ## Main definition
    20  
    21  * `cauchyPDFReal`: the function `x₀ γ x ↦ π⁻¹ * γ * ((x - x₀) ^ 2 + γ ^ 2)⁻¹`,
    22    which is the probability density function of a Cauchy distribution with location parameter `x₀`
    23    and scale parameter `γ` (when `γ ≠ 0`).
    24  * `cauchyPDF`: `ℝ≥0∞`-valued pdf, `cauchyPDF μ v x = ENNReal.ofReal (cauchyPDFReal μ v x)`.
    25  * `cauchyMeasure`: a Cauchy measure on `ℝ`, parametrized by a location parameter `x₀ : ℝ` and a
    26    scale parameter `γ : ℝ≥0`.  If `γ = 0`, this is `dirac x₀`, otherwise it is defined as the
    27    measure with density `cauchyPDF x₀ γ` with respect to the Lebesgue measure.

    29  -/
